notes.note: Blakiston made his BE this week but isn't setting the game alight. He is one you could hold as he will certainly get a game but any opportunity to upgrade should be considered.
Just 3 disposals for Blakiston. He missed his already low BE.
Blakiston continues to struggle to score. He can't be held and needs to be traded.
If you are still holding Blakiston you need to move him on. Just 8 disposals and 11 hitouts this week. But it is the BE of 71 which is a score he hasn't reached all season that is the big issue.
Blakiston is losing money and fast. This was his second lowest and he hasn't been over 50 in the last three now.
Big job for Blakiston this week up against Gawn and he did struggle to score with just 8 disposals and 7 hitouts. If you haven't traded already you should look at it as his value will plummet.
Blakiston couldn't get going even when English was out and he was had 52% CBAs to Peter Wright's 44%. This is not a great split for Blakiston owners. It is time to move on from Lachie.
Blakiston now has three in the 60s in a row as he beat his BE and now has one of 53 and he is pushing the limit on how long we can hold him.

Blakiston had his hands full with the bigger bodied Sweet. His score was serviceable but again free kicks against were the issue with 4. A BE of 43 means you can hold for now but he isn't going to have the big scores we hoped and with Xerri this week it could be difficult to score well

Blakiston has the number 1 ruck role for now with the news that Bryan is unlikely to play VFL until round 5. He didn't have a big score but there were 5 free kicks against up against a couple of good rucks. So hopefully this will be his floor score.
